conditional_robustness: If the preregistered validation rule selects a stochastic boosted cost selector, additionally refit that same configuration on all permitted mode costs with seeds 1 and 2. Keep the relevance component identical. Run each added controller once per final theorem under the primary budget. If the selector is deterministic linear, these duplicate fits/runs are unnecessary.
selection_rule: Final test outcomes never select a seed or change the primary seed-zero result. Seed comparisons are descriptive repeated-policy sensitivity on the same theorems, not independent theorem samples.
runs: 1344 main preregistered runs, plus 96 robustness runs only if a stochastic controller is selected. Same two-worker execution and per-arm budgets.
